contract: Open the preloaded movie and seek one track by ID and demux timestamp using SeekJob. FFmpeg uses +noparse+nofillin and avformat_index_get_entry_from_timestamp with AVSEEK_FLAG_BACKWARD.
Run both fresh and after draining packets and payloads to EOF. The candidate uses the existing complete-source index view, with the strict or bounded recovery opener named by the case.

Fold kind 3, entry presence, timestamp, absolute file position, size, signed index flags, minimum distance, and zero-based index ordinal in that order. A null reference entry is kind 3 with presence zero. A candidate first-key fallback is a real landing. An input refusal is kind 8. A negative public index size that causes ENOMEM in the drain is a format refusal.
Arguments are track ID, timestamp, EOF flag, window bytes, work quantum and candidate table policy. Input loading and argument parsing precede the observation window.
